hero.title: Samvad Setu
hero.description: A digital platform that connects citizens, government, universities, and industry on one system, turning civic complaints into tracked, fundable, resolvable action — built for Smart India Hackathon 2026.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.p1: Citizens across Jharkhand encounter local challenges (education, healthcare, agriculture, water, sanitation, environment, rural livelihoods, accessibility, urban infrastructure, public service delivery) but have no structured way to submit them for systematic resolution.
problem.p2: Universities have research expertise and student capacity; industry has technical/financial resources — but citizen–university–industry collaboration today is fragmented and ad hoc.
problem.p3: NEP 2020 calls for exactly this kind of experiential, multidisciplinary, community-engaged model — Samvad Setu is built to deliver it.

pillars.title: Multimodal Citizen Reporting
pillars.description: Voice, photo, geotag, and text reporting via app, WhatsApp, IVR, and web.

pillars.title: Geospatial Mapping & Smart Routing
pillars.description: Vulnerability hotspot mapping across all 24 districts of Jharkhand, auto-forwarding verified issues to 447+ HEIs (e.g. IIT-ISM, BAU).

pillars.title: Actionable R&D Pipelines
pillars.description: Converts raw complaints into structured, fundable engineering research projects instead of one-off repairs.

pillars.title: CSR Funding Bridge
pillars.description: Connects validated community challenges to regional industrial CSR funds for rapid prototyping and deployment.

pillars.title: Proactive Prevention & Transparency
pillars.description: Catches slow-building disasters early and sends citizens live progress updates to build public trust.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
steps: Citizen Input (App / WhatsApp / IVR / Image / Voice)
Language Layer (Hindi / Hinglish / English normalization + translation)
AI Engine (category classification, severity detection, duplicate detection, department routing)
Decision Layer (confidence + priority → Auto-Route or Human Review)
howItWorks.example: Citizen reports "no water for 3 days" in Hindi → AI classifies it as Category: Water, Severity: High, Department: Water Supply, Confidence: 94% → auto-routed and tracked, with status updates sent back to the citizen.

rnd.title: R&D Pipeline
rnd.flow: Citizen Reporting → AI & Validation → Geospatial Mapping → R&D Matching Engine → Funding Bridge → Prototype Development → Field Deployment → Monitoring & Impact → Citizen Feedback → Better Communities

csr.title: CSR Funding Pipeline
csr.flow: Identify Validated Issue → Find Relevant CSR Partners → Proposal Preparation → Approval & Funding Allocation → Project Implementation → Monitoring & Reporting → Scale & Sustain

categories.name: Backend & AI services
categories.items: Node.js/Express (API gateway) with Python/FastAPI AI services behind it

categories.name: AI/ML
categories.items: Multilingual NLP (IndicBERT/MuRIL-class models), Sentence-Transformers + FAISS for deduplication, PyTorch, scikit-learn, spaCy/NLTK

categories.name: Database & storage
categories.items: PostgreSQL + MongoDB Atlas (dual-database), Redis + BullMQ (job queue), Cloudinary

comparison.title: Why Samvad Setu Is Different
comparison.desc: Compared to Jharkhand Jan Samvad, SACHET (NDMA), and Bhuvan (ISRO), Samvad Setu is the only platform offering university/HEI routing with NEP 2020 credit transfer, an industry/CSR funding bridge, multimodal AI cross-language deduplication, and offline-first voice input with Santali support.

citizen.title: About Citizen Portal
citizen.content: As a citizen, you can report local issues using photos, voice notes, and geotags. Track the real-time status of your grievances and see the SLA countdown. Our AI automatically classifies and routes your report. Note that complex problems may be routed to universities or industry for deeper R&D solutions.

hei.title: About HEI Portal
hei.content: Universities and HEIs can 'adopt' civic challenges as NEP-2020-aligned capstone or R&D projects. Assign student and faculty teams to build prototypes, earn academic credits, and submit solution proposals for CSR funding.

industry.title: About Industry & CSR Portal
industry.content: Discover lab-ready solutions engineered by universities. Commit milestone-based CSR escrow funding (30/40/30 structure), monitor field deployment, and seamlessly certify civic handovers in alignment with MCA Section 135.

government.title: About Government Portal
government.content: Access district-wise analytics and dashboards showing domain-wise distribution, institutional participation, and industry engagement. Prioritize complaints, review workflows, and track SLA compliance across the state.
